name: Celestus
description: Large mechanical device hidden in the woods, once used during the Harvesttide festival.

timeline.summary: Arlinn meets a false white stag and realizes it is a trick by Katilda.
timeline.quote: a stag, pure white, beneath a branch festooned with carved silver

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds the witches' enclave beneath an arch of the Celestus.
timeline.quote: she now sees an enclave: branches and hides fashioned into tents

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda declares her people the Dawnhart Coven.
timeline.quote: We are the Dawnhart Coven.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn names herself and says she wants answers before the dawn is gone.
timeline.quote: My name is Arlinn Kord

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda explains the plan: return to Harvesttide traditions and gather people beneath the Celestus to restore the balance.
timeline.quote: Together, we can draw on our collective strength beneath the Celestus and, through it, restore the balance.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn objects that gathering so many humans invites an attack.
timeline.quote: Putting that many humans in one place is begging for an attack.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda says the Moonsilver Key is needed to activate the Celestus.
timeline.quote: we need the Moonsilver Key to activate it

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda warns that without the proper ritual the night will overtake the day.
timeline.quote: then the night will overtake the day

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: At the Celestus Leinore sees that the witches are binding human teeth into necklaces for the festivalgoers, and Katilda calls them werewolf teeth.
timeline.quote: "They are teeth," she said plainly. "Werewolf teeth."

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Jagger accuses the witches of stealing from the missing villagers and the crowd turns angry.
timeline.quote: "Did you steal those from the missing villagers?"

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Sinnia, wearing the mask, calms the crowd with a speech and the villagers shout to bring back the light and gather around her.
timeline.quote: "Bring back the light."

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Over the next days Sinnia replaces Leinore as the Sovereign of Harvesttide and makes villagers cough up small snakes while the crowd rejoices.
timeline.quote: Sinnia had replaced Leinore as the Sovereign of Harvesttide in the eyes of the festivalgoers.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda offers Sinnia a coven headpiece in exchange for the mask, and Sinnia laughs in her face.
timeline.quote: But Sinnia laughed in Katilda's face and turned away.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Leinore, Sinnia and Katilda return to the settlement, where freed festivalgoers wander dazed and remember nothing, though many remain missing.
timeline.quote: Soon, they found people stumbling around, wondering among themselves how they got there and which day of the festival it was.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: At the festival under the Celestus, witch Deidamia carves pumpkin suns for children while the witches wait for the key.
timeline.quote: A sun and moon engrave themselves on the spot the girl picks

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The heroes arrive to cheers, but a ward falls and howling begins.
timeline.quote: Deidamia feels the too-sharp pain of a ward going down.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Howlpack shamans and hundreds of wolves attack the barriers while the witches usher the festivalgoers toward the center of the Celestus.
timeline.quote: doesn't see them beating against the barriers until the shaman-wolves are already upon them

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sends Kaya off with the Moonsilver Key to deliver it to Katilda, and Chandra and Adeline ride to the front.
timeline.quote: "Kaya, take the key. Make sure it gets to Katilda."

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The magical barrier shatters and the wall of werewolves crashes into the festivalgoers.
timeline.quote: Overhead, the magic shatters like stained glass

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi plants his staff and slows time to hold back the sunset, calling on the witches to start the ritual.
timeline.quote: "Witches of the Dawnheart Coven!" he bellows, "Let's get this ritual started!"

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline commands the cathars in shield walls while Teferi's time magic stutters a dire's hammer.
timeline.quote: Clusters of cathars stand back to back with spears and shields

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn smashes a dire's knee with a mace and the cathars finish him, and the dire names her Tovolar's favorite.
timeline.quote: "You. Tovolar's favorite ."

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn confronts Tovolar and demands he call off the raid; he refuses.
timeline.quote: He smirks, shakes his head. "No."

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn attacks Tovolar with a mace, which he catches and tears from her hands.
timeline.quote: Tovolar catches the head of the mace.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn punches Tovolar and offers to let him take the nights back if he spares the humans, but he rejects it.
timeline.quote: Take the nights back, hunt what you can, but leave the humans out of this.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar transforms and presses her; Arlinn takes a sword from a fallen guard and Tovolar claws her cheek.
timeline.quote: his claws tear open her cheek.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Her wolves close in and Patience begs Arlinn to join the hunt; Arlinn says she cannot, and Boulder bowls her over.
timeline.quote: True to his name, when he throws his weight against her, she's bowled over

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar pins Arlinn and demands she show him the real Arlinn; the sun sets and Arlinn changes into a wolf.
timeline.quote: The sun sinks below the horizon. Day changes to night.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Witch, werewolf and cathar defend the Sungold Lock against Tovolar's assault.
timeline.quote: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.

citation.text: Defend the Celestus (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Moonsilver Key must be reunited with the Sungold Lock to restore the day-night balance.
timeline.quote: To restore the day-night balance, the Celestus mechanism's Sungold Lock must be reunited with its long-lost key.

citation.text: Moonsilver Key (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tovolar attacks the Harvesttide festival; Teferi delays the sunset and cathars led by Adeline fight the werewolves.
timeline.quote: Tovolar began his attack on the Harvesttide festival

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual and takes the Key, and the Eternal Night begins.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren appeared, interrupting the ritual and taking the Key with her

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's army attacks the Harvesttide festival and the planeswalkers, cathars and witches fight the werewolves.
timeline.quote: Cathars, witches and planeswalkers fought the werewolves to protect the humans .

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn feigns surrender and overpowers Tovolar, who retreats with the pack.
timeline.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar with a deathgrip in his chest.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn throws the Key to Olivia to save Katilda, beginning the Eternal Night.
timeline.quote: Deciding quickly, Arlinn threw the Key to the vampire, and Olivia hurled Katilda's body to the ground.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The coven organizes a Harvesttide festival to undo what is wrong with the moon.
timeline.quote: the Dawnhart coven decided to organize a Harvesttide festival

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's howlpack attacks the festival; the Gatewatch helps and Teferi slows the sunset.
timeline.quote: Teferi slowed the sunset

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn feigns surrender and overpowers Tovolar, who retreats with the pack.
timeline.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya brings the Key to Katilda, letting the ritual begin.
timeline.quote: letting the witches begin the ritual

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual, takes the Key, and drops Katilda; Arlinn cannot save her and the Eternal Night begins.
timeline.quote: This left the ritual unfinished, and the Eternal Night a fact.

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's werewolves attack the barrier around the festival, and the Gatewatch helps the witches.
timeline.quote: In human form, hundreds of werewolves attacked the magical barrier put up around the festival.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi slows the sunset while Adeline and Chandra organize defense and Kaya delivers the Moonsilver Key to Katilda.
timeline.quote: Knowing that they would be overpowered when it became night, Teferi slowed the sunset.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn faces Tovolar and changes form when night falls.
timeline.quote: When the night finally fell, Arlinn changed form.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn feigns surrender then overpowers Tovolar, who retreats with his pack.
timeline.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar with a death grip around his chest.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual and takes the Key, leaving the ritual unfinished and the Eternal Night a fact.
timeline.quote: but Olivia Voldaren appeared to interrupt the ritual again and took the Key with her.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar attacks the festival; Kaya brings the Key to Katilda and the ritual begins.
timeline.quote: Kaya 's intangibility let her run through the attack to bring the Key to Katilda

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia interrupts the ritual, uses Katilda as hostage, takes the Key and hurls Katilda to the ground.
timeline.quote: After Olivia obtained the Key she launched Katilda towards the ground

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Moonsilver Key and Sungold Lock are joined, the Celestus awakens, and the Eternal Night ends.
timeline.quote: The balance between night and day was restored.

citation.text: "Moon of Innistrad", section "Eternal Night". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's howlpack attacks the festival while Kaya delivers the Key to Katilda.
timeline.quote: Kaya delivered the Key to Katilda

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Katilda offers her soul into the Key, but Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual and takes the Key.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren appeared and interrupted the ritual by taking the Key with her.

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Key and Sungold Lock are joined; the Celestus roars to life and the balance between night and day is restored.
timeline.quote: The balance between night and day was restored.

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn brings the Moonsilver Key to the Celestus, but Tovolar launches a full-scale attack on the Harvesttide Festival.
timeline.quote: Tovolar launched a full-scale attack upon the festival

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Harvesttide Massacre". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi casts a spell to delay the sunset and stall the werewolves' transformation while planeswalkers, witches and cathars defend the humans.
timeline.quote: Teferi cast a powerful spell to delay the sunset

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Harvesttide Massacre". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn confronts Tovolar, who refuses to stop and urges her to join him; they fight until Tovolar calls on the wolves of her old pack and overpowers her.
timeline.quote: Tovolar refused and goaded Arlinn

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Harvesttide Massacre". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's spell ends, the sun sets, and all werewolves including Arlinn transform.
timeline.quote: Teferi's spell finally ended and the sun set, transforming all werewolves, including Arlinn

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Harvesttide Massacre". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn's wolf pack joins Tovolar, except Patience; Arlinn feigns surrender, then severely wounds Tovolar, who retreats with the pack.
timeline.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar and severely wounded him

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Harvesttide Massacre". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn, in wolf form, attacks Tovolar at the festival and he throws her to the ground.
timeline.quote: Forward. Powerful legs send her flying through the air

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar slams Arlinn into a split tree trunk, and she tears out a piece of wood and drives it through his leg.
timeline.quote: she has pierced him all the way through

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Streak, Redtooth and Boulder pin Arlinn down, and she is stunned by a blow to the head.
timeline.quote: there is Streak with his jaws firmly locked on her already wounded shoulder

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar urges Arlinn to join the hunt and says that the Church hates part of her but the pack does not.
timeline.quote: "Join the hunt," he says.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar she is home so he lets her up, then drives her claws into his sternum.
timeline.quote: She drives her claws deep into his sternum.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar Innistrad is home, and he calls her a liar.
timeline.quote: "You lied," he rasps.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar agrees to call off the attack, and the wolves howl a retreat.
timeline.quote: The howl goes up soon after that, a call for retreat only the wolves understand.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn surveys the aftermath, which survivors call the Harvesttide Massacre, and resolves that the ritual must be completed.
timeline.quote: the word has already been formed: massacre .

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Adeline pick up the wounded Arlinn and take her to the Celestus.
timeline.quote: Shifting to her human form, Arlinn takes Chandra's hand.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The Dawnhart Coven, Katilda holding the key and Kaya waiting beside her, performs the chanting ritual at the central platform.
timeline.quote: Katilda, her mask shading much of her face, the Moonsilver Key held in her hands like something sacred and pure

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The witches call Arlinn as the Child of Blood and Fang and ask whether she will spill blood for the day; she agrees.
timeline.quote: "Child of Blood and Fang. You stand on the line of Dawn, where Night and Day meet."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn anoints the bowl of the Sungold Lock with her blood and a bitter herb, and the Celestus stirs to life.
timeline.quote: So, too, does the Celestus.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda offers a root and her soul to the bowl; her soul streams out of her eyes and mouth and her body goes limp.
timeline.quote: a silver glow comes over them, then streams out

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren crashes down in a streak of red and gold, seizes Katilda and reaches for the key; Arlinn dives and secures it.
timeline.quote: Katilda swallowed up in its impossible color.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia offers to trade Katilda for the key and cuts her chest to force a decision.
timeline.quote: she rakes her claws across Katilda's chest.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The witches say the ritual had to be done by Katilda, so Arlinn throws the key to Olivia.
timeline.quote: Arlinn hurls the key with her good arm.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia throws Katilda toward the altar, injuring them both, and flies away with the key.
timeline.quote: By the time the world stops spinning, the vampire is gone.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: With the key gone, the Celestus falls silent and night settles on Innistrad for eternity.
timeline.quote: It is night on Innistrad.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar and his wolves arrive to help, and with the Key secured Teferi speeds the journey back to complete the ritual and restore balance.
timeline.quote: Tovolar and his wolves arrived to help

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the balance is restored, Arlinn sees Adeline and Chandra embracing under a willow tree.
timeline.quote: Arlinn observed Adeline and Chandra together

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Katilda is returned to her body and the coven restores the balance of night and day; she lends the Key to Teferi.
timeline.quote: the balance between night and day was restored

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Celestus Arlinn joins the key and the Sungold Lock, and the Celestus roars to life.
timeline.quote: But that worry dies the instant gold meets silver.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A column of light runs to the moon and the sun rises over Innistrad for the first time in months.
timeline.quote: Together they watch the first sunrise over Innistrad in months.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A team of Arlinn, Teferi, Chandra, Kaya and Adeline obtains the Moonsilver Key from Markov Manor and returns to the Celestus.
timeline.quote: obtained the Key from Markov Manor and returned to the Celestus

citation.text: "Celestus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tovolar and his werewolf army attack the Harvesttide festival before the ritual can start; cathars, planeswalkers and witches defend the humans.
timeline.quote: Tovolar and his werewolf army attacked the Harvesttide festival before the ritual could start.

citation.text: "Celestus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya takes the Key to Katilda at the center of the Celestus.
timeline.quote: while Kaya took the Key to the central area of Celestus where Katilda waited

citation.text: "Celestus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual by taking the Key.
timeline.quote: But Olivia Voldaren interrupted the ritual by taking the Key.

citation.text: "Celestus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Key and Lock are joined; the Celestus awakens, a column of light reaches the moon and the moon begins to descend, restoring the balance of night and day.
timeline.quote: The balance between night and day was thus restored.

citation.text: "Celestus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia flees, and the ritual at the Celestus with the restored key ends the Eternal Night.
timeline.quote: the vampire matriarch opted to flee rather than perish

citation.text: "Eternal Night", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: enclave near it; used it in a ritual
relations.quote: Near the Celestus is the enclave of the Dawnhart Coven

citation.text: "Celestus", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: Massive ancient stone arches in the Kessig woods with a central platform and a lock of bright gold, once used to balance day and night.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

pages_say.description: An ancient artifact whose pieces arc over the woods and whose center is the site of the ritual.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

pages_say.description: A golden glowing structure with metallic rings in the Ulvenwald where the festival camp and the witches' dais are set up.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

pages_say.description: The ancient structure at the center of the festival where the people shelter.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

pages_say.description: A mechanism that governs the day-night balance, defended by witch, werewolf and cathar.

citation.work: Innistrad: Midnight Hunt: card flavor text
